name: Scar Tissue Radio
creator: Broadcast collective known only as 'The Keloid'
description: Originating from a repurposed water reclamation substation in Shelf District 7, Scar Tissue Radio is an unfiltered audio feed broadcasting survival news, mutual aid coordinates, and raw testimonials from Tier 1 residents. Hosts rotate anonymously to avoid Axiom Security suppression, and the show is distributed via low-bandwidth audio compression through cracked BCI channels and salvaged speakers mounted in tunnel junctions. It is equal parts community bulletin board, grief archive, and defiant noise.
medium: pirate audio broadcast / cracked BCI low-bandwidth feed
cultural_impact: Scar Tissue Radio functions as the de facto emergency communication network for entire Shelf districts where corporate infrastructure has been deliberately degraded, making it a lifeline that no corponation has successfully killed despite repeated attempts.
controversy: Axiom Security classifies it as a sedition platform after a 2209 episode broadcast the names and shift schedules of undercover Compliance officers embedded in Shelf markets. Three suspected operators were detained; the show returned within four days.
story_hooks: A player character receives a Scar Tissue Radio broadcast containing their own name — listed as a corporate informant — and has 48 hours to find out who submitted the tip before the Shelf acts on it.

The Keloid collective reaches out to an outsider to physically transport a hard drive of archived broadcasts to an off-site location after their substation is raided, but the drive contains more than audio.
A beloved anonymous host goes silent mid-episode; listeners organize a search that pulls them into the politics of who controls the Shelf's underground communication infrastructure.
